description: This file implements functions for handling Android binder status, including creating, converting, and pruning status and exception codes, as well as retrieving status descriptions.

methods.name: AStatus_newOk
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of a successful AStatus.

methods.name: AStatus_fromExceptionCode
methods.description: Creates an AStatus object from an exception code.

methods.name: AStatus_fromExceptionCodeWithMessage
methods.description: Creates an AStatus object from an exception code and message.

methods.name: AStatus_fromServiceSpecificError
methods.description: Creates an AStatus object from a service-specific error code.

methods.name: AStatus_fromServiceSpecificErrorWithMessage
methods.description: Creates an AStatus object from a service-specific error code and message.

methods.name: AStatus_fromStatus
methods.description: Creates an AStatus object from a binder status.

methods.name: AStatus_isOk
methods.description: Checks if the AStatus indicates success.

methods.name: AStatus_getExceptionCode
methods.description: Retrieves the exception code from an AStatus.

methods.name: AStatus_getServiceSpecificError
methods.description: Retrieves the service-specific error code from an AStatus.

methods.name: AStatus_getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the binder status from an AStatus.

methods.name: AStatus_getMessage
methods.description: Gets the exception message from an AStatus.

methods.name: AStatus_getDescription
methods.description: Returns a string description of the AStatus.

methods.name: AStatus_deleteDescription
methods.description: Deletes the description string allocated by AStatus_getDescription.

methods.name: AStatus_delete
methods.description: Deletes an AStatus object if it is not the singleton OK status.

methods.name: PruneStatusT
methods.description: Converts a status_t to a pruned binder status code.

methods.name: PruneException
methods.description: Converts an exception code to a pruned binder exception code.
